title: Dating the Lapse of a Travel Credit on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Where a reissue fee falls due on a lapsed travel credit under Air Ticket Fare Brands, two matters settle the day from which the credit is treated as having stood unclaimed, and so settle the time the credit has stood unclaimed: whether the fare brand that produced the vouchers makes credits transferable, and how many vouchers stand lapsed on the booking. In every position the period runs to the handling date.

**Where the fare brand that produced the vouchers makes credits non-transferable and more than one voucher stands lapsed on the booking, what opens the count?**

How long the credit has stood unclaimed is counted from the day the booking's cancellation was confirmed to the handling date. In this position neither the issue day nor the lapse day of any voucher opens the count.

**Where the fare brand that produced the vouchers makes credits transferable and more than one voucher stands lapsed on the booking, what opens the count?**

How long the credit has stood unclaimed is counted from the day the most recent voucher on the booking was issued to the handling date. Where several vouchers stand on the booking it is the issue day of the one most recently issued, not of the earliest, that opens the count.

**In any other case, what opens the count?**

How long the credit has stood unclaimed is counted from the day the most recent voucher on the booking lapsed to the handling date. This is the position in any other case, including a booking carrying a single lapsed voucher, and it holds whether the fare brand makes credits transferable or non-transferable.

The three positions, by the two matters that decide them:

| Vouchers standing lapsed on the booking | Credits under the fare brand held | Day the count opens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| More than one | Non-transferable | The day the booking's cancellation was confirmed |
| More than one | Transferable | The day the most recent voucher on the booking was issued |
| Not more than one | Either | The day the most recent voucher on the booking lapsed |

In each position the count closes on the handling date, and the months between the day the count opens and the handling date are the time the credit has stood unclaimed on that booking.
